# Automatically Generated define Statements for Instance Variables

#define a self->a->val

#define b self->b->val

#define d self->d->val

#define c self->c->val

/* BEGIN handwritten code */

/* calc 1 */a = b + d;

/* calc 2 */c = a * c;

/* END handwritten code */

#undef a

#undef b

#undef d

#undef c
